slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of fighter jets required to train one pilot in a single year?
slot_scores.rationale: The question asks the inverse form of the per-jet training capacity, and the user answer confirms one training jet trains five pilots per year.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarified the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when the training program starts or how long training lasts. It only asked about aggregation and production/training availability, not the hidden training timeline.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in Year 1 and Year 2, effectively starting in Year 1 and lasting through Year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the training program's start year or duration, but its READY_TO_MODEL model includes training allocations x1 and x2 for both years.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot was resolved, but the P1 training start/duration slot remained unclarified when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the essential per-jet training capacity but stopped with the training start/duration still unresolved, silently assuming a two-year training timeline. It also never addressed the low-severity pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
